criteria.observation: The reconciler receives all full records, including extra fields, repeated IDs and occurrence order.
The recorded first request, continuations, empty pages, bounds and repeat rejection satisfy the request contract.
A transport or decode failure after an earlier page is reported to the caller without returning a partial export as complete.
A different wire format behind the same decoded interface preserves the observed records and request sequence.
The submitted tests accept a contract-compliant collector and detect lost detail and a partial success on failure. Credit each independent detection.
